点商品图片，或用扫码枪扫
en: Tap a picture, or scan with the scanner

zh: 扫码枪一扫就加进账单
en: A scan adds it to the bill

en: Cash is rounded to the 5 sen

en: Stock goes down at once — the phone app sees it too
